verified: A UK tribunal ruled against the Home Office and held that it must acknowledge issuing a technical capability notice to Apple, and rejected London's argument that disclosure would harm national security, according to the Financial Times.
unconfirmed: The notice's substance, scope and date, whether Apple has challenged it, whether the tribunal's reasoning is published, and whether the Home Office will appeal — all of these rest on the FT's account, and no text of the ruling was available.

verified: 据《金融时报》报道，英国该法庭裁定内政部须承认曾向苹果发出秘密的技术能力通知，并驳回了政府以国家安全为由拒绝披露的主张。
unconfirmed: 这道通知具体索取什么、涉及苹果哪项功能或产品、是否附带保密义务期限，报道均未说明；内政部是否会提出上诉、苹果作何回应也尚无消息。裁决由单一媒体《金融时报》报道，尚未见法院文书或政府声明独立印证。

titles.en: UK tribunal orders Home Office to admit secret Apple encryption notice
titles.zh: 英国法庭裁定内政部须承认曾向苹果发出秘密“技术能力通知”
